column1: # Authored expectation for the Phase-14 test-surface join.
# Section S clause 2: the run enumerates its test surfaces and joins them completely to an
# independently authored expectation. Phase 14 is the one phase spanning two registers, so
# its enumeration mixes Register-1 chain/Step evidence with Register-2 boundary evidence.
# owner is the registry the ids are enumerated from at run time:
#   items     the validation-locus entries and mutant names the run read
#   metrics   the metric keys in gen/dsl/phase14/phase-results.tsv
#   checks    the check ids tools/phase14_gate.py implements
# Six surfaces join to source-level checks the gate has always performed but never named:
# the raw `Step` constructor export scan, the dry-run import closure, the subprocess
# primitive-site inventory, the partial-token scan, the independent step-set oracle, and the
# fake-tool executability check. Naming them is what lets the ledger cite them.
# **13 contract surfaces carry no id**, so the ledger carries them UNVERIFIED
# rather than asserting results the run did not produce. The gap is recorded against
